_doc: TrajPE data v3 pre-registration (machine-readable; human-readable version: data/DATASETS_V3.md). Written 2026-10-21 BEFORE preparing any new dataset; the SHA-256 of this file and of data/DATASETS_V3.md as pre-registered are in frozen/datasets_v3_preregistration.sha256 (copies in frozen/datasets_v3_preregistration_20261021.tgz). Only public metadata was used to write it (OSM relations via Nominatim, Hugging Face / figshare / SNAP / GitHub metadata, public category lists). The 'expected' sizes are the counts of the 2026-10-20 survey (research:datasets, approximate rules); no rule uses them except as a forecast of the size rule, which is applied to the prepared data. The code registry (trajpe/data.py DATASETS, trajpe/public_catalog.py PUBLIC_BBOX) must equal this file (checked by the data v3 validation).
preregistered: 2026-10-21 (exact UTC time in the header of frozen/datasets_v3_preregistration.sha256)

rules.scope: All 15 Massive-STEPS cities; TSMC2014 NYC and TKY; Gowalla (SNAP check-ins + Liu et al. spot categories) in 3 cities plus a development-only NYC instance. Semantic Trails (STD) cities are NOT part of data v3 (not required by the goal); STD's categories.csv is used only as the public list of the Foursquare category names that Massive-STEPS uses.
rules.study_area: Bounding box, rounded to 4 decimals, of the polygon part of the OSM relation that contains the relation's Nominatim centre point (Nominatim lookup 2026-10-21, frozen/datasets_v3_osm_20261021.json). This rule reproduces the v2 areas of nyc, istanbul, tokyo (mainland), sao_paulo and kuwait_city exactly; jakarta keeps its v2 area (union of the 5 mainland city relations; its relation R6362934 is a single polygon that includes the Thousand Islands). Relations: Massive-STEPS cities use the relation of Massive-STEPS' own boundary file (data/<city>/<city>_<relation>_overpass.geojson, github.com/cruiseresearchgroup/Massive-STEPS); TSMC-NYC and Gowalla-NYC use R175905 (as nyc); the Gowalla cities use the city's administrative relation chosen on 2026-10-20 before any in-area count. v2 areas are unchanged.
rules.catalog: FSQ OS Places, local dump do-me/foursquare_places_100M (2024-11-19, 103,486,864 rows), inside the study area, built by the unchanged v2 code (trajpe/public_catalog.py build_public_catalogs): first category label, the 10 FSQ roots, the v2 HOME_NAMES filter unchanged, duplicates by venue id removed.
rules.category_map: category_map_v3 (data/processed/category_map_v3.json): one fixed function evaluated on full public source taxonomies against the frozen leaf list frozen/fsq_leaves_v2.json (the 1,132 leaf categories of the 6 v2 catalogs). (a) Foursquare names: domain = all 937 names of Semantic Trails categories.csv (commit 19b569066d29) plus all TSMC2014 NYC/TKY category names; every v2 entry (data/processed/category_map_v2_to_fsq.json, 731 names) is kept unchanged and this is asserted; a new name gets the normalized-name match in the frozen leaves, else the choice of Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (vLLM, temperature 0, structured choice over the frozen leaves, the v2 system and user prompts of scripts/map_categories_v2_to_fsq.py). (b) Gowalla: key 'gowalla:<category id>' (the number in the category URL; names are ambiguous, e.g. 'Subway' is the sandwich chain (454) and the metro (164)); domain = every category id in gowalla_spots_subset1.csv and in gowalla_category_structure.json; normalized-name match, else the same LLM step with a Gowalla user prompt that also gives the public category path. Private residences (gowalla:21 Home, 20 Apartment, 29 Condo, 87 Duplex) map to both public residential leaves (MULTI_TARGET, as v2 'Home (private)'). (c) Overrides only for clear errors visible from the public taxonomy alone (wrong kind of place), decided once before any synthesis, each listed with its reason in the map's provenance; private check-ins are never consulted. v2 datasets keep the v2 map; new datasets use the v3 map (identical on every v2 name). The LLM step runs once, through the shared GPU queue (TRAJPE_VLLM_UTIL 0.40).
rules.record_mapping: unchanged v2 trajpe.public_catalog.map_checkins: rows outside the study area are dropped; each check-in goes to the nearest public venue of its mapped category within 300 m, else of that category within 1 km, else of its root within 300 m, else any venue within 500 m, else it is dropped.
rules.trail_rules: unchanged v2 trajpe.data._segment, applied per trail after the record-level mapping: split internal gaps > 8 h, keep the first 20 check-ins, drop trails shorter than 2.

loaders.massive_steps: existing trajpe.data._load_massive_steps: the official Massive-STEPS tabular split (train/validation/test) and trail ids; timestamps are UTC and are converted to the IANA zone; rows without coordinates are dropped (record-level).
loaders.tsmc: existing trajpe.data._load_tsmc: UTC time plus the per-row offset; trails by the 8 h rule over each user's sequence in the file; random 70/10/20 split by trail with numpy default_rng(0) over the trails in (user, time) order (exactly as the v2 tokyo dataset).
loaders.gowalla: new trajpe.data._load_gowalla. SNAP loc-gowalla check-ins (UTC 'Z'). For each user, over the user's full worldwide sequence sorted by UTC time (file order for ties), the Semantic Trails construction rules (D2KLab/semantic-trails create_std.py, re-implemented): a check-in is invalid if it is at the same location id as the previous raw check-in, less than 60 s after it, or implies a haversine speed above 343 m/s (dt <= 0 counts as invalid); an invalid check-in is dropped but stays the reference for the next check-in; a valid check-in at least 8 h after the previous raw check-in (or a user's first check-in) starts a new segment; a segment's trail starts at its first valid check-in within 8 h of the previous raw check-in, preceded by that previous check-in, and contains all later valid check-ins of the segment. UTC is converted to the IANA zone. Category key 'gowalla:<id>' from Liu et al. gowalla_spots_subset1.csv by location id; check-ins without one are dropped (record-level) in prepare(). Split per trail by a salted hash: u = (first 8 bytes of SHA-256('trajpe-data-v3/gowalla-split/' + trail_id), big-endian) / 2^64; train if u < 0.7, val if u < 0.8, else test. No user-level filters.

rules.size_rule: After preparation, a new dataset goes to the main tables iff its train split has >= 10,000 trails (meta.json train.trails); otherwise to a separate low-data table (same methods, eps and seeds). Applied mechanically, once, before any synthesis on new data; no dataset is dropped, moved or replaced because of results.

roles.tuning: the only dataset on which hyper-parameters are tuned or synthetic results inform decisions (jakarta).
roles.development: sanity checks during development; reported, flagged as development city (nyc).
roles.evaluation: never inspected during method development; main tables; the primary analysis set for win counts and paired tests.
roles.evaluation_devcity: main tables, flagged (dagger): same city as development (NYC) and, for tsmc_nyc, the same raw Foursquare 2012-13 source as the 2013 part of nyc; never used for tuning; reported in the secondary analysis set (primary set + dev-city datasets).
roles.evaluation_lowdata: new datasets below the size rule; separate low-data table.
roles.untouched_test: run once, last, after the go/no-go and all method decisions are recorded; reported as it comes out.
roles.development_pipeline_only: prepared for a simulator-only pipeline smoke test after design freeze 3; never in result tables.

rules.technical_checks: Gates, all decided before any synthesis on new data: (1) catalog: >= 10,000 public venues in the study area and, after preparation, share_drop <= 0.05 (catches holes in the local FSQ dump, e.g. northern Japan); (2) time: the argmin over the 24 local hours of the pooled check-in hour histogram lies in [2, 6] (else the time conversion is wrong and is fixed); (3) loader unit checks pass; (4) the 6 v2 datasets re-prepared with the v3 code into a scratch TRAJPE_DATA are byte-identical. A Gowalla dataset that fails (1) is replaced by the pre-registered backup gw_dallas; a Massive-STEPS or TSMC dataset that fails is reported as failed, with the reason, and is not replaced.
rules.reporting: Every pre-registered dataset is reported. Primary analysis set: role 'evaluation' in the main tables. Secondary: primary + 'evaluation_devcity' + 'development'. Low-data table and untouched test are separate. Flags: tangerang overlaps the tuning city's study area (not unseen); ms_tokyo has the same study area as tokyo (different source and era); bandung and palembang are in the tuning city's country.
rules.no_synthesis_before_freeze: Owner's rule: no synthesis (not even simulator-only) and no new metric on any new dataset before TrajPE design freeze 3. Before the freeze, loaders are validated only with counts, the time check, schema checks and the v2 byte-identity regression. After the freeze, the first run on new data is a simulator-only smoke test on gw_nyc.
rules.untouched_test_draw: Recorded on 2026-10-20 (research:datasets) and reproduced on 2026-10-21: rng = numpy.random.default_rng(20261020); pools in the order [Foursquare 2012-13 new: bandung, moscow, petaling_jaya, std13_bangkok, std13_mexico_city, std13_singapore], [Swarm 2017-18: std18_osaka, std18_rio_de_janeiro], [Gowalla: gw_austin, gw_san_francisco, gw_stockholm] (each sorted), one rng.choice per pool -> std13_singapore, std18_rio_de_janeiro, gw_austin. STD is out of scope, so only gw_austin applies; no re-draw.
rules.dp: delta = 1e-6 < 1/n for every dataset; n_out = 50,000 (public constant); study area, catalog and category map are public; preprocessing is record-level or within one raw trail (Gowalla trail construction, like STD/Massive-STEPS/TSMC, is within each user's sequence); the Gowalla split is a per-trail hash; Massive-STEPS inherits Massive-STEPS' user filter (users with >= 3 trails), TSMC inherits the TSMC2014 release.

module_entries._doc: Entries other modules must add for the new datasets (they are not edited by data v3): trajpe/api_llm.py CITY_NAMES and baselines/dplora/textfmt.py CITY_NAMES (must stay identical) = display_name; baselines/common.py CITIES, baselines/dplora/jobs.py CITIES (+ TOKENS_M, estimated in data/DATASETS_V3.md after preparation), baselines/run_main_v2.sh CITIES, and the CITIES / CITY_TEX lists of scripts/{collect_results,eval_downstream_all,postprocess_all,make_tables,rescore_baselines,make_matrix}.py = the dataset names; tex = suggested CITY_TEX label. 'platform' tells whether the prompt wording 'Foursquare check-in trails' applies (a method decision for design freeze 3).
